# Parity Gaps & Implementation Audit: Vanilla Java 26.3 vs Neth (Rust)

## Summary of Parity Audit
- **Minecraft Target Version**: 26.3 (Protocol 777, Data Version 5023)
- **Reference Java Source**: `jvmc/src/net/minecraft/` (Mojang official mappings)
- **Rust Engine**: `Neth/crates/pumpkin-core`
- **Audit Outcome**: 30 critical gaps audited, aligned to vanilla, and verified via unit tests.

---

## Gap 1: Control Tick Order & `JumpControl` in `server_ai_step`
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob.serverAiStep()` (lines 740-748):
  ```java
  profiler.push("controls");
  profiler.push("move");
  this.moveControl.tick();
  profiler.popPush("look");
  this.lookControl.tick();
  profiler.popPush("jump");
  this.jumpControl.tick();
  profiler.pop();
  profiler.pop();
  ```
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED**
  - Integrated `jump_control: Mutex<JumpControl>` into `MobEntity`.
  - Added helper `mob_entity.jump()`.
  - Ordered ticks in exact vanilla sequence: `move_control` -> `look_control` -> `jump_control`.
  - Verified with `jump_control_lifecycle_and_tick_parity` test.

---

## Gap 2: GoalSelector Tick Decoupling & Flag Masking
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.GoalSelector.tick()` & `tickRunningGoals(boolean forceTickAll)`.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED**
  - `goal_selector.rs` implements running goal cleanups, disabled flag masking, replacement checks, and `tick_all || prioritized_goal.should_run_every_tick()`.
  - All ported movement and interaction goals properly register required flags (`Controls::MOVE`, `Controls::LOOK`, `Controls::JUMP`, `Controls::TARGET`).

  - Clears expired memories with tick countdowns.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED & VERIFIED**
  - `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/ai/brain/` implements core activities, activity switching, memory expiration decay, and behavior scheduling.

## Gap 4: GroundPathNavigation Jump and Door Interaction
- **Vanilla Reference**: `GroundPathNavigation.java`:
  - Automatically requests `mob.getJumpControl().jump()` when the path node requires stepping up.
  - Handles opening and closing wooden doors when `canOpenDoors()` is true.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED**
  - Path node evaluation interacts with `mob.jump()` and `jump_control` to initiate step-ups cleanly without bypassing physics.

## Gap 5: `AvoidEntityGoal` Monster Dynamic Filtering Predicate
- **Vanilla Reference**: `Rabbit.java:128`:
  ```java
  this.goalSelector.addGoal(4, new RabbitAvoidEntityGoal<>(this, Monster.class, 4.0F, 2.2, 2.2));
  ```
- **Neth Issue**: `AvoidEntityGoal` only accepted a single static `flee_type: &'static EntityType`.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED**
  - Upgraded `AvoidEntityGoal` to support optional dynamic `target_predicate: Option<Box<TargetPredicate>>`.
  - Added constructor `AvoidEntityGoal::for_monsters(flee_distance, slow, fast)` that filters all candidates where `entity.get_entity().entity_type.category == &MobCategory::MONSTER`.
  - Added accessor `flee_type(&self) -> Option<&'static EntityType>`.
  - Verified with unit test `avoid_entity_goal_monster_predicate`.

## Gap 123: Living Entity Damage Invulnerability Cooldown & Partial Damage Calculation Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `LivingEntity.java:1218-1268` (`hurtServer`), `LivingEntity.java:1960-1979` (`actuallyHurt`):
  - In vanilla Minecraft:
    ```java
    boolean tookFullDamage = true;
    if (this.damageCooldownTime > 10.0F && !source.is(DamageTypeTags.BYPASSES_COOLDOWN)) {
       if (damage <= this.lastHurt) {
          return false;
       }

       this.actuallyHurt(level, source, damage - this.lastHurt);
       this.lastHurt = damage;
       tookFullDamage = false;
    } else {
       this.lastHurt = damage;
       this.damageCooldownTime = 20;
       this.actuallyHurt(level, source, damage);
       this.hurtDuration = 10;
       this.hurtTime = this.hurtDuration;
    }
    ```
  - `this.lastHurt` tracks raw incoming damage before armor absorption and enchantments.
  - If a hit arrives within the 10-tick invulnerability cooldown (`damageCooldownTime > 10`):
    - If `damage <= this.lastHurt`: the hit is completely discarded (`return false`). No armor damage, no sound, no knockback, no animation.
    - If `damage > this.lastHurt`: the entity receives the difference `damage - this.lastHurt` passed to `actuallyHurt` (which then applies armor/magic absorption). `tookFullDamage` is `false`, so knockback, hurt animations, hurt sounds, and hurt event packets are NOT replayed.
  - In previous Neth implementation:
    - Armor reduction and magic reduction were calculated before the cooldown check, and then compared `effective_amount <= last_damage` (comparing post-armor damage against pre-armor damage). This caused subsequent stronger hits during the invulnerability window to be rejected incorrectly or severely under-damaged (`effective_amount - last_damage` resulted in subtracting raw damage from post-armor damage).
    - Armor durability was damaged before the cooldown check, wasting durability even on discarded hits.
    - Even for partial hits (`tookFullDamage == false`), hurt animation packets, broadcast events, knockback, and hurt sounds were erroneously triggered.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED & VERIFIED**
  - Implemented `calculate_cooldown_damage(raw_damage, last_damage, hurt_cooldown, bypasses_cooldown) -> Option<(f32, bool)>` in `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`.
  - Refactored `LivingEntity::damage_with_context`:
    - Checks cooldown and computes `damage_to_apply` and `took_full_damage` upfront.
    - Calculates armor damage and absorption on `damage_to_apply` inside the `actuallyHurt` sequence.
    - Updates `last_damage_taken` to the raw incoming damage.
    - Guards hurt animations, knockback velocity, damage event broadcasting, and hurt sound playback behind `took_full_damage`.
  - Verified in unit test `test_damage_cooldown_and_partial_hit_parity`.

- **Vanilla Reference**: `CombatTracker.java:37-54, 147-160`, `ServerPlayer.java:565-574, 895-924, 950`, `LivingEntity.java:730, 2780-2782`, `ClientboundPlayerCombatEnterPacket.java`, `ClientboundPlayerCombatEndPacket.java`:

        - If previously `inCombat`: calls `mob.onLeaveCombat()`.
        - For players (`ServerPlayer.onLeaveCombat`), sends `ClientboundPlayerCombatEndPacket` (`CCombatEnd`) with `duration = tickCount - combatStartTime`.

    - `this.getCombatTracker().recheckStatus()` is executed upon death, cleanly terminating combat and clearing entries.
  - Combat Timestamps:
    - Vanilla tracks entity age ticks (`this.mob.tickCount`). Previously in Neth, `damage_with_context` incorrectly read `world.level_info.load().day_time`, which breaks combat tracking whenever the time of day changes or players sleep in beds.

## Gap 125: Shield Blocking Angle Projection, Durability Function & Axe Disable Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `LivingEntity.java:1311-1348` (`applyItemBlocking`), `BlocksAttacks.java:105-116, 127-135, 159-167, 188-193`, `Items.java:2428-2439`, `Item.java:493-495`, `Warden.java:176`:
  - `LivingEntity.applyItemBlocking`:
    - Angle Calculation:
      ```java
      Vec3 sourcePosition = source.getSourcePosition();
      double angle;
      if (sourcePosition != null) {
         Vec3 viewVector = calculateViewVector(0.0F, this.getYHeadRot());
         Vec3 vectorTo = sourcePosition.subtract(this.position());
         vectorTo = new Vec3(vectorTo.x, 0.0, vectorTo.z).normalize();
         angle = Math.acos(vectorTo.dot(viewVector));
      } else {
         angle = (float) Math.PI;
      }
      ```
    - Previously in Neth, `(pos - player_pos)` was normalized BEFORE setting `y = 0.0`. When the attacker and defender were on different elevations (jumping, stairs, slabs, hill terrain), the pre-normalized vector had reduced horizontal length (`< 1.0`), distorting the dot product angle calculation and causing blocks to fail erroneously even when facing directly at the attacker.
    - Zeroing `y` before normalization preserves accurate horizontal direction regardless of elevation.
  - Shield Durability Damage Function:
    - In vanilla Minecraft `DataComponents.BLOCKS_ATTACKS` for shields uses `ItemDamageFunction(3.0F, 1.0F, 1.0F)`:
      ```java
      public int apply(final float dealtDamage) {
         return dealtDamage < this.threshold ? 0 : Mth.floor(this.base + this.factor * dealtDamage);
      }
      ```
    - Hits `< 3.0F` (punch, snowball, weak attack) deal **0** durability damage to the shield.
    - Hits `>= 3.0F` deal `floor(1.0 + damage)` durability damage (e.g. 5.0 damage deals 6 durability damage).
    - Previously in Neth, all hits took `(amount).floor().max(1.0)` durability damage, inappropriately damaging the shield on trivial hits and under-damaging on strong hits.
  - Weapon Disabling:
    - Axes have `disableBlockingForSeconds = 5.0F` (100 ticks cooldown).
    - Warden melee has `getSecondsToDisableBlocking = 5.0F`.
    - Projectiles (`#minecraft:is_projectile`) cannot trigger shield disable or attacker pushback.
- **Neth Status**: **RESOLVED & VERIFIED**
  - Implemented `can_block_damage_source(entity_pos, head_yaw, damage_pos) -> bool` with proper `y = 0.0` projection before normalization.
  - Implemented `calculate_shield_durability_damage(dealt_damage) -> i32` mirroring `BlocksAttacks.ItemDamageFunction(3.0F, 1.0F, 1.0F)`.
  - Refactored `damage_with_context` in `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/living.rs` to use these helpers.
  - Verified in unit tests `test_shield_blocking_angle_and_durability_parity`.

## Gap 126: Knockback Direction, NO_KNOCKBACK / NO_IMPACT Tags & Hurt Indication Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `LivingEntity.java:1237-1253` (`hurtServer`), `LivingEntity.java:1293-1309` (`dealDefaultKnockback`), `LivingEntity.java:1647-1665` (`knockback`), `ServerPlayer.java:2169-2172` (`indicateDamage`):
  - `dealDefaultKnockback`:
    ```java
    public void dealDefaultKnockback(final DamageSource source, final float damage, final boolean blocked) {
       double xd = 0.0;
       double zd = 0.0;
       if (source.getDirectEntity() instanceof Projectile projectile) {
          DoubleDoubleImmutablePair knockbackDirection = projectile.calculateHorizontalHurtKnockbackDirection(this, source);
          xd = -knockbackDirection.leftDouble();
          zd = -knockbackDirection.rightDouble();
       } else if (source.getSourcePosition() != null) {
          xd = source.getSourcePosition().x() - this.getX();
          zd = source.getSourcePosition().z() - this.getZ();
       }

       this.knockback(0.4F, xd, zd, source, damage);
       if (!blocked) {
          this.indicateDamage(xd, zd);
       }
    }
    ```
  - `hurtServer` checks:
    - `!source.is(DamageTypeTags.NO_IMPACT)`: Call `markHurt()` only when damage is impactful (skipping drowning, starvation, freezing, generic_kill).
    - `!source.is(DamageTypeTags.NO_KNOCKBACK)`: Call `dealDefaultKnockback` only when the damage type does not have `#minecraft:no_knockback` (skipping fire, lava, suffocation, fall, drown, etc.).
    - Previously in Neth:
      - `NO_KNOCKBACK` was not checked at all; entities took knockback on every tick of fire damage from an attacker entity.
      - `mark_hurt()` was only called if `source` was an entity; environmental/block damage did not sync velocity.
      - Hurt animation yaw used direct entity position difference even for projectiles and ignored positional damage without entity source.
      - When `(xd, zd) == (0.0, 0.0)`, hurt indication yaw returned 0 instead of `-yaw`.

  - Implemented `calculate_hurt_direction_yaw(xd, zd, entity_yaw) -> f32` mirroring Vanilla `ServerPlayer.indicateDamage`: `(float)(Mth.atan2(zd, xd) * 180.0F / (float)Math.PI - this.getYRot())`.

       if (source.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity livingSource
          && !source.is(DamageTypeTags.NO_ANGER)
          && (!source.is(DamageTypes.WIND_CHARGE) || !this.is(EntityTypeTags.NO_ANGER_FROM_WIND_CHARGE))) {

       }
    }

When a player attacked an entity, the `if attacker.get_player().is_some()` branch consumed the event, completely bypassing `last_hurt_by_mob_id.store(...)`.
    - Consequently, mobs attacked by players never registered the player in `last_hurt_by_mob_id`, breaking neutral mob revenge/anger AI targeting.
    - `#minecraft:no_anger` and `#minecraft:no_anger_from_wind_charge` tag checks were absent.

    private void handleHandSwap(final Map<EquipmentSlot, ItemStack> changedItems) {
       ItemStack currentMainHand = changedItems.get(EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND);
       ItemStack currentOffHand = changedItems.get(EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND);
       if (currentMainHand != null
          && currentOffHand != null
          && ItemStack.matches(currentMainHand, this.lastEquipmentItems.get(EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND))
          && ItemStack.matches(currentOffHand, this.lastEquipmentItems.get(EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND))) {
          ((ServerLevel)this.level()).getChunkSource().sendToTrackingPlayers(this, new ClientboundEntityEventPacket(this, (byte)55));
          changedItems.remove(EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND);

          this.lastEquipmentItems.put(EquipmentSlot.OFFHAND, currentOffHand.copy());
       }
    }
    ```

    protected void updatePlayerPose() {
       if (this.canPlayerFitWithinBlocksAndEntitiesWhen(Pose.SWIMMING)) {
          Pose desiredPose = this.getDesiredPose();
          Pose actualPose;
          if (this.isSpectator() || this.isPassenger() || this.canPlayerFitWithinBlocksAndEntitiesWhen(desiredPose)) {

    if (this.isSwimming()) {
       double lookAngleY = this.getLookAngle().y;

          || this.jumping
          || !this.level().getFluidState(BlockPos.containing(this.getX(), this.getY() + 1.0 - 0.1, this.getZ())).isEmpty()) {

    }

      - Activation condition: `lookAngleY <= 0.0 || is_jumping || head_submerged`.

    public float getDestroySpeed(final BlockState state) {
       float speed = this.inventory.getSelectedItem().getDestroySpeed(state);
       if (speed > 1.0F) {
          speed += (float)this.getAttributeValue(Attributes.MINING_EFFICIENCY);
       }
       if (MobEffectUtil.hasDigSpeed(this)) {
          speed *= 1.0F + (MobEffectUtil.getDigSpeedAmplification(this) + 1) * 0.2F;

       if (this.hasEffect(MobEffects.MINING_FATIGUE)) {
          int amplifier = this.getEffect(MobEffects.MINING_FATIGUE).getAmplifier();

       if (this.isEyeInFluid(FluidTags.WATER)) {
          speed *= (float)this.getAttribute(Attributes.SUBMERGED_MINING_SPEED).getValue();

       }

    }

## Gap 173: Witch Potion Drinking Decisions & Sound Pitch, Ranged Splash Potion Selection & Self-Damage Immunity Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**:
  - `Witch.java:134-173` (aiStep):
    - Khi không uống thuốc, Witch cân nhắc uống một bình Potion:
      - `rand < 0.15 && isEyeInFluid(FluidTags.WATER) && !hasEffect(WATER_BREATHING)` -> Potion::WATER_BREATHING
      - `rand < 0.15 && (isOnFire() || lastDamageSource.is(DamageTypeTags.IS_FIRE)) && !hasEffect(FIRE_RESISTANCE)` -> Potion::FIRE_RESISTANCE
      - `rand < 0.05 && health < maxHealth` -> Potion::HEALING
      - `rand < 0.5 && target != null && !hasEffect(SPEED) && dist_sq > 121.0` -> Potion::SWIFTNESS
    - Âm thanh khi uống potion: `SoundEvents.WITCH_DRINK`, pitch `0.8F + random.nextFloat() * 0.4F`.
    - Khi uống xong: xóa modifier giảm tốc `minecraft:drinking` (-0.25 speed), áp dụng hiệu ứng potion.
  - `Witch.java:209-220` (getDamageAfterMagicAbsorb):
    - Miễn nhiễm hoàn toàn với sát thương do chính mình gây ra:
      `if (damageSource.getEntity() == this) { damage = 0.0F; }`
    - Kháng 85% sát thương phép thuật:
      `if (damageSource.is(DamageTypeTags.WITCH_RESISTANT_TO)) { damage *= 0.15F; }`
  - `Witch.java:223-269` (performRangedAttack):
    - Lựa chọn potion ném:
      - Nếu target là `Raider` đồng minh:
        - `target.getHealth() <= 4.0F` -> Potion::HEALING
        - else -> Potion::REGENERATION
        - Reset target (`setTarget(null)`)
      - Nếu target là kẻ thù:
        - `dist >= 8.0 && !target.hasEffect(SLOWNESS)` -> Potion::SLOWNESS
        - `target.health >= 8.0 && !target.hasEffect(POISON)` -> Potion::POISON
        - `dist <= 3.0 && !target.hasEffect(WEAKNESS) && rand < 0.25` -> Potion::WEAKNESS
        - Mặc định: Potion::HARMING
    - Âm thanh ném splash potion: `SoundEvents.WITCH_THROW`, pitch `0.8F + random.nextFloat() * 0.4F`.

Việc trước đó chỉ kiểm tra tag khiến Spider, CaveSpider và Nautilus vô tình bị dính hiệu ứng Poison, vi phạm trực tiếp logic miễn nhiễm của Java edition.

Cave Spider hoàn toàn không có jockey hay các hiệu ứng ngẫu nhiên này.

      - `canContinueToUse()`: người chơi còn sống, đang bơi và khoảng cách `< 256.0` (16 blocks).
      - `start()`: cấp hiệu ứng `DOLPHINS_GRACE` 100 ticks (5 giây) cho người chơi.
      - `stop()`: xóa player reference và dừng navigation.
      - `tick()`: nhìn về phía người chơi (`look_at_with_range`); nếu khoảng cách `< 6.25` (2.5 blocks) thì dừng navigation, ngược lại bơi theo người chơi với tốc độ `4.0`; nếu người chơi đang bơi và tỉ lệ `random.nextInt(6) == 0` thì gia hạn hiệu ứng `DOLPHINS_GRACE` 100 ticks.

      - Ngoại lệ đặc biệt: `Squid`, `GlowSquid`, `Dolphin`, và `Axolotl` có thể được dắt dây dắt (`canBeLeashed() -> true`).

        - Phát âm thanh `SoundEvents.FROG_TONGUE` tại vị trí Ếch (category Neutral, volume 2.0, pitch 1.0).

            - Biến thể Cold (`FrogVariant::Cold`): rơi 1 `minecraft:verdant_froglight`.
      - Sau 10 ticks (`eatAnimationTimer >= 10`):

      - `CUSTOM`: `CUSTOM_HEAD`.
    - Placement / instrument derivation (`setInstrument`):
      - If block above has `worksAboveNoteBlock()` (`type != BASE_BLOCK`, i.e. skull / mob head), note block takes that mob head instrument.

    - Pitch calculation: `getPitchFromNote(note) = 2.0^((note - 12) / 12.0)`. Note 0 is 0.5 (one octave down), Note 12 is 1.0 (base pitch), Note 24 is 2.0 (one octave up). Mob head instruments are not tunable and always play at fixed pitch `1.0`.
    - Sound volume: `NOTE_VOLUME = 3` (3.0f).
    - Particle emission: When playing a tunable note block, spawns `ParticleTypes.NOTE` at `(x + 0.5, y + 1.2, z + 0.5)` with motion vector `(note / 24.0, 0.0, 0.0)` which clients use as the color hue on the color wheel.

### Gap 293: Comparator Subtraction/Compare Mode Logic, Item Frame Signal Input & Power Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**:

    - Signal logic:
      - Compare mode: if `input_signal >= side_signal` -> outputs `input_signal`, else `0`.
      - Subtract mode: if `input_signal > side_signal` -> outputs `input_signal - side_signal`, else `0`.
    - Powered state (`shouldTurnOn`):
      - `input > side`: turns ON in both Compare and Subtract modes.
      - `input == side`: turns ON in Compare mode, turns OFF in Subtract mode (`input - side == 0`).
      - `input < side` or `input == 0`: turns OFF in both modes.
    - Attached item frame reading behind solid block:
      - If frame has item: output is `1 + (rotation % 8)` (1 to 8).
      - If frame is empty: output is 0.
      - Only reads if exactly 1 item frame hangs on the target block.

      - Slot selection is permitted strictly on the front face matching `FACING`. Hits from top, bottom, sides, or back are ignored.
      - Relative planar coordinates are computed per horizontal face:
        - North: `(1.0 - hitX, hitY)`.
        - South: `(hitX, hitY)`.
        - West: `(hitZ, hitY)`.
        - East: `(1.0 - hitZ, hitY)`.
      - Grid indexing:
        - `row = clamp(floor((1.0 - hitY) / 0.5), 0, 1)`.
        - `column = clamp(floor(hitX / (1.0 / 3.0)), 0, 2)`.
        - `slot = column + row * 3`.
        - Top row ($Y > 0.5$): slot 0 (left), slot 1 (middle), slot 2 (right).
        - Bottom row ($Y < 0.5$): slot 3 (left), slot 4 (middle), slot 5 (right).
    - Comparator analog output (`getAnalogOutputSignal`):
      - Emits `lastInteractedSlot + 1` (signal strength 1 to 6 upon interaction, 0 when undisturbed).

### Gap 343: Copper Bulb Redstone T-Flip-Flop Toggle, Flip on Rising Edge, Lit State Persistence & Comparator Parity

- **Description**:
  - In Vanilla Minecraft 1.21, the Copper Bulb behaves as a built-in T-flip-flop:
    - Maintains two synchronized boolean blockstate properties: POWERED (whether currently receiving redstone power) and LIT (whether lamp light is on).
    - Rising edge detection (checkAndFlip):
      - When redstone power transitions from unpowered to powered (hasSignal != powered and !powered):
        - Inverts LIT state (
ewState = newState.cycle(LIT)).
        - Plays SoundEvents.COPPER_BULB_TURN_ON if transitioning to lit, or SoundEvents.COPPER_BULB_TURN_OFF if transitioning to unlit.
        - Sets POWERED = true.
    - Falling edge detection:
      - When redstone power is removed (!hasSignal && powered):
        - Resets POWERED = false.
        - The LIT state persists unchanged, and no sound is emitted.
    - Comparator Output:
      - Analog output signal is 15 if LIT is true, 0 if LIT is false.
    - Weathering Light Emission Parity:
      - Lit Unweathered: light level 15
      - Lit Exposed: light level 12
      - Lit Weathered: light level 8
      - Lit Oxidized: light level 4
      - Waxed variants retain identical light emission levels.
      - All unlit variants emit 0 light.

### Gap 354: Vault Shutter Audio/Particle Events (3015/3016/3017), Graduated Ejection Pitch (0.8..1.2), Failed Key 15-Tick Sound Cooldown & Light Levels (6/12) Parity

- **Vanilla Reference**: `VaultState.java:14-55, 57-60, 84-100, 138-153`, `VaultServerData.java:18-35, 129-132`, `VaultBlockEntity.java:263-278, 353-361`, `VaultBlock.java:48-61`.
- **Description**:
  - In Vanilla Minecraft 1.21, the Vault container incorporates stateful timings, particle world events, light level transitions, fail sound cooldowns, and progressive item ejection pitch:
    - **World Events**:
      - `AnimationVaultActivate (3015)`: Dispatched when entering `ACTIVE` state with ominous flag data (`isOminous ? 1 : 0`).
      - `AnimationVaultDeactivate (3016)`: Dispatched when entering `INACTIVE` state (`isOminous ? 1 : 0`).
      - `AnimationVaultEjectItem (3017)`: Dispatched with data 0 for each ejected item above the vault.
    - **Dynamic Light Levels**:
      - `INACTIVE` state emits light level 6 (`HALF_LIT = 6`).
      - `ACTIVE`, `UNLOCKING`, and `EJECTING` states emit light level 12 (`LIT = 12`).
    - **Failed Insertion Sound Cooldown (15 Ticks)**:
      - When an invalid key is inserted or a player who has already claimed rewards tries to open the vault again, failure sounds (`SoundEvents.VAULT_INSERT_ITEM_FAIL` and `SoundEvents.VAULT_REJECT_REWARDED_PLAYER`) are throttled by a 15-tick cooldown (`INSERT_FAIL_SOUND_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 15`), preventing sound spam from fast clicks.
    - **Graduated Ejection Pitch (0.8..1.2)**:
      - As items are ejected, `SoundEvents.VAULT_EJECT_ITEM` plays at increasing pitch calculated from ejection progress:
        $$\text{Progress} = \begin{cases} 1.0 & \text{if } \text{total} \le 1 \\ 1.0 - \frac{\text{remaining} - 1}{\text{total} - 1} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$
        $$\text{Pitch} = 0.8 + 0.4 \times \text{Progress}$$
        This produces a rising musical crescendo from 0.8 up to 1.2 on the final drop.
    - **Timings**:
      - Display item loot cycling rate is 20 ticks (1 second).
      - Delay before first ejection, between ejections, and after last ejection are all 20 ticks.
- **Neth Changes**:
  - Exported constants `INSERT_FAIL_SOUND_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 15`, `DISPLAY_ITEM_CYCLE_TICK_RATE = 20`, `DELAY_BEFORE_FIRST_EJECTION_TICKS = 20`, `DELAY_BETWEEN_EJECTIONS_TICKS = 20`, `DELAY_AFTER_LAST_EJECTION_TICKS = 20`, `EVENT_VAULT_ACTIVATE = 3015`, `EVENT_VAULT_DEACTIVATE = 3016`, `EVENT_VAULT_EJECT_ITEM = 3017`, `LIGHT_LEVEL_HALF_LIT = 6`, `LIGHT_LEVEL_LIT = 12`, `EJECTION_Y_OFFSET = 1.2`, and `EJECTION_VELOCITY = 2.0` in `VaultBlock`.
  - Added helper functions `get_light_level`, `can_play_insert_fail_sound`, `calculate_ejection_progress`, and `calculate_ejection_pitch`.
  - Added `last_insert_fail_timestamp` with atomic access and fail sound cooldown throttling to `VaultBlockEntity`.
  - Updated item ejection in `VaultBlock` to emit `WorldEvent::AnimationVaultEjectItem` and calculate increasing pitch per item via `calculate_ejection_pitch`.
  - Added unit test `test_vault_shutter_audio_particles_graduated_pitch_and_cooldown_parity` in `combat.rs`.

### Gap 361: Breeze Combat AI: Shoot Inhale Delay (15 Ticks), Recovery (4 Ticks), Cooldown (10 Ticks), Difficulty Shoot Inaccuracy (5 - 4*Diff), Jump Inhale (10 Ticks), Jump Velocity (0.058333334 * Follow Range) & Allowed Jump Angles ([40, 55, 60, 75, 80]) Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.breeze.Breeze.java:41-300`, `BreezeAi.java:30-105`, `Shoot.java:18-84`, `LongJump.java:33-242`, `Slide.java:18-50`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Shoot Behavior & Timing*:
     - Max attack range: 16.0 blocks ($256.0$ squared distance) (`ATTACK_RANGE_MAX_SQRT = 256.0`).
     - Inhale charging delay: 15 ticks (`SHOOT_INITIAL_DELAY_TICKS = 15`), plays `SoundEvents.BREEZE_INHALE` (vol 1.0, pitch 1.0).
     - Shoot recovery delay: 4 ticks (`SHOOT_RECOVER_DELAY_TICKS = 4`).
     - Shoot cooldown: 10 ticks (`SHOOT_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 10`). Total attack sequence duration: 20 ticks.
     - Projectile speed: `PROJECTILE_MOVEMENT_SCALE = 0.7F`.
     - Uncertainty / inaccuracy formula: `5 - level.getDifficulty().getId() * 4` (Peaceful: 5, Easy: 1, Normal: -3, Hard: -7).
     - Target aim Y position: `(target.getY() + (isPassenger ? 0.8 : 0.3)) - breeze.getFiringYPosition()`.
  2. *Long Jump Behavior & Timing*:
     - Inhaling duration before leap: 10 ticks (`INHALING_DURATION_TICKS = 10`), plays `SoundEvents.BREEZE_CHARGE`.
     - Leap execution: sets `Pose.LONG_JUMPING`, `discardFriction = true`, plays `SoundEvents.BREEZE_JUMP`.
     - Landing: sets `Pose.STANDING`, `discardFriction = false`, plays `SoundEvents.BREEZE_LAND`.
     - Post-jump cooldown: 10 ticks normally, reduced to 2 ticks if hurt (`JUMP_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 10`, `JUMP_COOLDOWN_WHEN_HURT_TICKS = 2`).
     - Post-jump shoot trigger: prepares shooting memory for 100 ticks (`POST_LAND_SHOOT_MEMORY_TICKS = 100`).
     - Maximum jump velocity: `0.058333334F * follow_range` (with default 24.0 follow range = 1.4F).
     - Permitted jump angles: `[40, 55, 60, 75, 80]` degrees.
     - Clearance check: requires at least 4 unobstructed air blocks above position (`REQUIRED_AIR_BLOCKS_ABOVE = 4`), cannot leap from Honey Block or deep fluids.
     - Minimum jump distance check: if target distance $\le 4.0$ blocks (`TOO_CLOSE_FOR_JUMP_DISTANCE = 4.0`), jump is disallowed and Breeze slides or retreats.

### Gap 363: Wolf Sound Variants (7 Sets: Classic, Puglin, Sad, Angry, Grumpy, Big, Cute), Biome Spawn Priorities, Crackiness Particles & Damage Absorption Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.wolf.WolfVariants.java:1-85`, `WolfSoundVariants.java:1-75`, `WolfSoundVariant.java:1-51`, `Wolf.java:234, 275-298, 410-429, 609`, `Crackiness.java:1-42`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Wolf Sound Variants (7 Sound Sets)*:
     - 7 distinct sound sets registered in `WolfSoundVariants`: `CLASSIC`, `PUGLIN`, `SAD`, `ANGRY`, `GRUMPY`, `BIG`, `CUTE`.
     - Each sound set encapsulates adult and baby sound events for: ambient, hurt, death, step, growl, pant, and whine.
     - Natural spawning (`finalizeSpawn`) and baby breeding (`getBreedOffspring`) randomly assign one of the 7 sound variants via `pickRandomSoundVariant` (1/7 uniform distribution).
  2. *Ambient Sound Sub-Type Dispatch (`getAmbientSound`)*:
     - If angry: dispatches `growlSound()`.
     - Else if `random.nextInt(3) == 0`:
       - If tame and health < 20.0: dispatches `whineSound()`.
       - Else: dispatches `pantSound()`.
     - Else: dispatches `ambientSound()`.
  3. *Step Sound & Volume (`playStepSound`)*:
     - Uses `this.getSoundSet().stepSound().value()` at volume 0.15F and pitch 1.0F.
  4. *Wolf Armor Damage Absorption, Crackiness Thresholds & Particles (`actuallyHurt`)*:
     - Absorbs all damage except `#minecraft:bypasses_wolf_armor` (e.g. `out_of_world`, `generic_kill`, `cramming`, `drown`, `dry_out`, `freeze`, `in_wall`, `indirect_magic`, `magic`, `outside_border`, `starve`, `thorns`, `wither`).
     - Directly damages body armor instead of wolf health/absorption (`super.actuallyHurt` bypassed when armor absorbs).
     - Plays `ItemWolfArmorDamage` on hit (or `ItemWolfArmorBreak` if broken).
     - When crackiness level changes across thresholds (Low 0.95, Medium 0.69, High 0.32):
       - Plays `SoundEvents.WOLF_ARMOR_CRACK` (`ItemWolfArmorCrack`).
       - Emits 20 armadillo scute item particles with delta `(0.2, 0.1, 0.2)` and speed `0.1` at `(x, y + 1.0, z)`.
  5. *Biome Spawn Variant Priority Mapping (`WolfVariants`)*:
     - `minecraft:grove` -> `Snowy` (priority 1)
     - `minecraft:old_growth_pine_taiga` -> `Black` (priority 1)
     - `minecraft:snowy_taiga` -> `Ashen` (priority 1)
     - `minecraft:forest` -> `Woods` (priority 1)
     - `minecraft:old_growth_spruce_taiga` -> `Chestnut` (priority 1)
     - `#minecraft:is_savanna` (`savanna`, `savanna_plateau`, `windswept_savanna`) -> `Spotted` (priority 1)
     - `#minecraft:is_jungle` (`jungle`, `sparse_jungle`, `bamboo_jungle`) -> `Rusty` (priority 1)
     - `#minecraft:is_badlands` (`badlands`, `eroded_badlands`, `wooded_badlands`) -> `Striped` (priority 1)
     - Fallback -> `Pale` (priority 0)

       - `IDLE`: id 0, animation duration 0 ticks, never hides in shell.
       - `ROLLING`: id 1, animation duration 10 ticks (`ARMADILLO_ROLL_DURATION_TICKS = 10`), hides in shell after 5 ticks.
       - `SCARED`: id 2, animation duration 50 ticks (`ARMADILLO_SCARED_DURATION_TICKS = 50`), always hides in shell.
       - `UNROLLING`: id 3, animation duration 30 ticks (`ARMADILLO_UNROLL_DURATION_TICKS = 30`), hides in shell for first 26 ticks (`ticksInState < 26L`).
  2. *Threat Sensors & Predicates*:
     - Sensor runs every 5 ticks (`MobSensor(5, Armadillo::isScaredBy, Armadillo::canStayRolledUp, MemoryModuleType.DANGER_DETECTED_RECENTLY, 80)`).
     - Horizontal scare distance: 7.0 blocks (`ARMADILLO_SCARE_DISTANCE_HORIZONTAL = 7.0`), vertical scare distance: 2.0 blocks (`ARMADILLO_SCARE_DISTANCE_VERTICAL = 2.0`).
     - `isScaredBy`: Scared by Undead mobs (`EntityTypeTags.UNDEAD`), last attacker mob (`getLastHurtByMob() == entity`), or non-spectator players who are sprinting or riding vehicles.
     - `canStayRolledUp`: Returns true if not panicking, not in liquid, not leashed, and not a passenger/vehicle.
  3. *State Transitions & Peek Mechanics*:
     - Danger threshold: 75 ticks (`ARMADILLO_DANGER_THRESHOLD = 75`).
     - Peek timer: 50 ticks + random 100 to 400 ticks (`ARMADILLO_PEEK_MIN_TICKS = 100`, `ARMADILLO_PEEK_MAX_TICKS = 400`).
     - Broadcasts entity status 64 (`ARMADILLO_PEEK_EVENT_ID = 64`) to client to trigger peek animation and peek sound (`SoundEvents.ARMADILLO_PEEK`).
     - When danger ticks drop below `UNROLLING.animationDuration()` (30 ticks), switches to `UNROLLING` and plays `ARMADILLO_UNROLL_START`.
     - If danger reappears while unrolling (> 30 ticks), immediately switches back to `SCARED`.
  4. *Damage Reduction & Environmental Panic*:
     - Reduced damage formula when hidden in shell: `damage = (damage - 1.0F) / 2.0F`. Plays `SoundEvents.ARMADILLO_HURT_REDUCED`.
     - Environmental damage (`DamageTypeTags.PANIC_ENVIRONMENTAL_CAUSES` - fire, lava, cactus, freeze): triggers `rollOut()` immediately so armadillo flees rather than staying curled in fire.
  5. *Interactions & Sounds*:

     - Natural scute shed interval: 6000 to 12000 ticks (5 to 10 minutes).
     - Step sound: `SoundEvents.ARMADILLO_STEP` at volume 0.15F (`ARMADILLO_STEP_SOUND_VOLUME = 0.15`) and pitch 1.0F (`ARMADILLO_STEP_SOUND_PITCH = 1.0`).

### Gap 370: Trial Spawner Target Cooldown (36,000 Ticks), Shutter & Ejection Timings (40 / 30 Ticks), Periodic Player Detection Throttling (20 Ticks) & State Transitions Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.trialspawner.TrialSpawner.java:1-435`, `TrialSpawnerState.java:1-240`, `TrialSpawnerStateData.java:1-320`, `PlayerDetector.java:1-85`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Cooldowns & Timings*:
     - Default target cooldown length: 36,000 ticks = 30 minutes in-game (`DEFAULT_TARGET_COOLDOWN_LENGTH = 36000`).
     - Detection spawn delay: 40 ticks (`DETECT_PLAYER_SPAWN_BUFFER = 40`).
     - Shutter opening delay: 40 ticks after killing the last mob (`DELAY_BEFORE_EJECT_AFTER_KILLING_LAST_MOB = 40.0F`). Computed as `(float)serverLevel.getGameTime() >= (float)(cooldownEndsAt - targetCooldownLength) + 40.0F`.
     - Reward ejection interval: 30 ticks (`TIME_BETWEEN_EACH_EJECTION = 30`). Evaluated as `(float)(serverLevel.getGameTime() - (cooldownEndsAt - targetCooldownLength)) % 30.0F == 0.0F`.
     - Bad Omen to Trial Omen duration scaling: 18,000 ticks per amplifier level (`TRIAL_OMEN_PER_BAD_OMEN_LEVEL = 18000`).
     - Ominous item spawner interval: 160 ticks (`TICKS_BETWEEN_ITEM_SPAWNERS = 160`).
  2. *Player Detection & Line-of-Sight*:
     - Periodic detection check is throttled and staggered by block position: `(pos.asLong() + level.getGameTime()) % 20L != 0L` (`PLAYER_DETECTION_INTERVAL = 20`).
     - Line-of-sight requirement: the first player detected (`registered_players.is_empty()`) requires a direct line-of-sight raycast from the spawner center to the player's eye position. Subsequent players within `requiredPlayerRange` do not require line-of-sight (`requireLineOfSight = false`).
     - World events on player detection: emits `level.levelEvent(3019, pos, detectedPlayers.size())` (`ParticlesTrialSpawnerDetectPlayerOminous`) if ominous, or `level.levelEvent(3013, pos, detectedPlayers.size())` (`ParticlesTrialSpawnerDetectPlayer`) if normal.
  3. *Reward Ejection & State Machine Transitions*:
     - Reward items are dispensed upwards with an ejection vertical offset of 1.2 blocks (`Vec3.atBottomCenterOf(pos).relative(Direction.UP, 1.2)`) and velocity factor 2 (`DefaultDispenseItemBehavior.spawnItem(..., 2, Direction.UP)`), accompanied by `level.levelEvent(3014, pos, 0)` (`AnimationTrialSpawnerEjectItem`).
     - While in `COOLDOWN`: normal players do not re-trigger the spawner. However, if a player with Bad Omen / Trial Omen approaches, `tryDetectPlayers` detects them, transforms Bad Omen into Trial Omen, broadcasts event 3020, calls `applyOminous()`, and because `detectedPlayers` becomes non-empty, immediately transitions the spawner from `COOLDOWN` to `ACTIVE` (bypassing normal cooldown). When cooldown elapses naturally without ominous trigger (`isCooldownFinished`), it clears ominous status, resets state data, and transitions back to `WAITING_FOR_PLAYERS`.
- **Implementation**:

### Gap 373: Creaking Heart Natural Drop XP (20-24), Comparator Signal Scaling (32m / 0-15), Resin Clumps (2-3) & Hurt Audio Progress Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.CreakingHeartBlock.java:44-58, 63-71, 106-117, 177-181, 188-195`, `CreakingHeartBlockEntity.java:44-60, 80-97, 110-134, 225-247, 249-284, 338-346`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Natural Break Drop XP*:
     - When a naturally generated Creaking Heart (`state.getValue(NATURAL) == true`) is destroyed by a player, it drops 20 to 24 experience points (`this.popExperience(serverLevel, pos, level.getRandom().nextIntBetweenInclusive(20, 24))`) (`NATURAL_BREAK_MIN_XP = 20`, `NATURAL_BREAK_MAX_XP = 24`).
  2. *Comparator Output Signal Scaling*:
     - `computeAnalogOutputSignal()` formula: returns 0 if uprooted or no creaking protector is linked. When linked:
       `scaledDistance = Math.clamp(distance, 0.0, 32.0) / 32.0`
       `signal = 15 - (int)Math.floor(scaledDistance * 15.0)`
       At distance 0: output signal is 15. At distance 16: output signal is 8. At distance 32: output signal is 0. Clamped at max distance 32.0 (`COMPARATOR_MAX_DISTANCE = 32.0`, `COMPARATOR_MAX_SIGNAL = 15`).
  3. *Resin Clumps Spreading & Hurt Emitter Audio*:
     - When a linked Creaking takes damage, the Heart spreads 2 to 3 clumps of resin (`RESIN_CLUMPS_MIN = 2`, `RESIN_CLUMPS_MAX = 3`) (`level.getRandom().nextIntBetweenInclusive(2, 3)`) around adjacent Pale Oak Logs using BFS within depth 2 and max 64 nodes.
     - Hurt emitter sound progress: countdown from 100 ticks down to 0, playing `SoundEvents.CREAKING_HEART_HURT` every 10 ticks (`HURT_CALL_INTERVAL = 10`) at interpolated position between protector and heart: `progress = 0.2F + 0.8F * (100 - emitter) / 100.0F`, volume: `emitter / 2.0F / 100.0F + 0.5F`.
     - Dual trail particle emission: emits particles towards creaking (`16545810`) and towards heart (`6250335`) during the first 50 ticks of the hurt countdown (`emitter > 50`).
  4. *Range Limits & Grace Period*:
     - Roaming radius: 32 blocks (`CREAKING_ROAMING_RADIUS = 32`). Too far cutoff: 34 blocks (`DISTANCE_CREAKING_TOO_FAR = 34`).
     - Player detection range: 32 blocks (`PLAYER_DETECTION_RANGE = 32`).
     - Ticks grace period before clearing unresolved UUID: 30 ticks (`TICKS_GRACE_PERIOD = 30`).

### Gap 374: Eyeblossom State Transform Cascade Delay (`[d*5, d*10]` Ticks), Idle Sound Chance (1/700) & Bee Poisoning (25 Ticks) Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.EyeblossomBlock.java:25-48, 51-86, 89-105, 106-166`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.FlowerPotBlock.java:128-143, 148-154`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.bee.Bee.java:660-669`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Cascade Scheduled Tick Delay & Neighbor Search*:
     - When an Eyeblossom transforms (Open -> Closed or Closed -> Open), it scans adjacent blocks in `[-3, 3]` horizontally and `[-2, 2]` vertically (`EYEBLOSSOM_XZ_RANGE = 3`, `EYEBLOSSOM_Y_RANGE = 2`).
     - For each nearby eyeblossom sharing the old block state, it schedules a tick with delay:
       `delay = random.nextIntBetweenInclusive((int)(distance * 5.0), (int)(distance * 10.0))` (`CASCADE_MIN_DELAY_FACTOR = 5.0`, `CASCADE_MAX_DELAY_FACTOR = 10.0`).
       For adjacent blocks ($d = 1.0$), delay is in $[5, 10]$ ticks. For maximum diagonal corner ($d = \sqrt{22} pprox 4.6904$), delay is in $[23, 46]$ ticks.
  2. *Ambient Idle Sound*:
     - When an Eyeblossom is in the `OPEN` state, during `animateTick` it rolls a 1 in 700 chance (`EYEBLOSSOM_IDLE_SOUND_CHANCE = 700`).
     - If the block directly below is `Blocks.PALE_MOSS_BLOCK`, it plays `SoundEvents.EYEBLOSSOM_IDLE` at SoundSource `AMBIENT`, volume 1.0, pitch 1.0.
  3. *Bee Interaction & Poisoning*:
     - When an entity touches an Eyeblossom in non-peaceful difficulty, it checks: `entity instanceof Bee bee && Bee.attractsBees(state) && !bee.hasEffect(MobEffects.POISON)`.
     - In Vanilla, only `Blocks.OPEN_EYEBLOSSOM` is tagged `#minecraft:bee_attractive`. `CLOSED_EYEBLOSSOM` is NOT attractive and does NOT poison bees.
     - When touched by a bee without poison, it applies `MobEffects.POISON` for 25 ticks with amplifier 0 (`EYEBLOSSOM_BEE_POISON_TICKS = 25`).
  4. *Suspicious Stew & Particle Color*:
     - Open eyeblossom stew effect: `MobEffects.BLINDNESS` for 11.0 seconds (`OPEN_STEW_DURATION_SECONDS = 11.0`). Trail particle color: `16545810` (0xFC7932 / orange-gold).
     - Closed eyeblossom stew effect: `MobEffects.NAUSEA` for 7.0 seconds (`CLOSED_STEW_DURATION_SECONDS = 7.0`). Trail particle color: `6250335` (0x5F5F5F / grey).
  5. *Potted Eyeblossom Parity (`FlowerPotBlock.java`)*:
     - When potted eyeblossom transforms between `POTTED_OPEN_EYEBLOSSOM` and `POTTED_CLOSED_EYEBLOSSOM`, it spawns the transform particle matching the new type (orange-gold for potted open, grey for potted closed) and plays the long switch sound (`SoundEvents.EYEBLOSSOM_OPEN_LONG` or `SoundEvents.EYEBLOSSOM_CLOSE_LONG`).

### Gap 377: Creaking Gaze Freezing / Unfreezing Mechanics, Carved Pumpkin Bypass & Invulnerability Sway Animation Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.creaking.Creaking.java:128-135, 142-181, 215-241, 455-490`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity.java:217-224, 1762-1781`, `data/minecraft/tags/item/gaze_disguise_equipment.json:1-5`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Gaze Cone & Dot Product Threshold*:
     - In Vanilla `Creaking.java:471`, `this.isLookingAtMe(player, 0.5, false, true, this.getEyeY(), this.getY() + 0.5 * this.getScale(), (this.getEyeY() + this.getY()) / 2.0)`.
     - In `LivingEntity.java:1772`, the gaze formula is:
       `dot > 1.0 - coneSize / (adjustForDistance ? dist : 1.0)`.
     - Because `adjustForDistance` is `false` for Creaking (`CREAKING_LOOK_ADJUST_FOR_DISTANCE = false`), the denominator is strictly `1.0`, yielding a constant 60-degree cone threshold: `dot > 1.0 - 0.5 = 0.5` (`CREAKING_LOOK_DOT_THRESHOLD = 0.5`).
     - Gaze targets 3 vertical height points on the Creaking: `getEyeY()`, `getY() + 0.5 * getScale()`, and `(getEyeY() + getY()) / 2.0`.
     - Line of sight check is performed using `ClipContext.Block.VISUAL` and `ClipContext.Fluid.NONE` from player's eye to each target height. If `clip.is_miss` is true, player has clear visual line of sight.
  2. *Carved Pumpkin Disguise Bypass Logic*:
     - Vanilla `Creaking.java:470`: `(!active || LivingEntity.PLAYER_NOT_WEARING_DISGUISE_ITEM.test(player))`.
     - Tag `#minecraft:gaze_disguise_equipment` contains `minecraft:carved_pumpkin`.
     - When dormant/inactive (`active == false`): Player looking at Creaking activates it within 144.0 blocks sq (12m) regardless of whether they wear a carved pumpkin.
     - When active (`active == true`): Wearing a carved pumpkin bypasses the gaze check, meaning looking at an active Creaking does NOT freeze it; the Creaking continues pursuing and attacking normally. Undisguised players looking at an active Creaking freeze it (`can_move = false`).
  3. *Freeze & Unfreeze Sounds & Velocity Zeroing*:
     - When transition from moving to frozen occurs (`now_can_move == false && can_move == true`): calls `stop_in_place()` (zeroing velocity and stopping navigator) and plays `SoundEvents.CREAKING_FREEZE` (`Sound::EntityCreakingFreeze`).
     - When transition from frozen to moving occurs (`now_can_move == true && can_move == false`): plays `SoundEvents.CREAKING_UNFREEZE` (`Sound::EntityCreakingUnfreeze`).
  4. *Invulnerability Sway Animation & Status Byte*:
     - Normal damage against a heart-bound Creaking does not deplete health; instead it triggers status byte 66 (`CREAKING_STATUS_INVULNERABLE_SWAY = 66`), duration 8 ticks (`INVULNERABILITY_ANIMATION_DURATION = 8`), and plays `Sound::EntityCreakingSway`.
     - When the damage source is attributed to a player, it triggers `creakingHeartBlockEntity.creakingHurt()`.
  5. *Attack Animation & Status Byte*:
     - When attacking a target, Creaking broadcasts status byte 4 (`CREAKING_STATUS_ATTACK = 4`), duration 15 ticks (`ATTACK_ANIMATION_DURATION = 15`), and plays `Sound::EntityCreakingAttack`.
- **Implementation**:
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`:

    - Added helper functions `is_creaking_gaze(dot)` and `should_creaking_freeze_from_player(is_active, is_disguised)`.
    - Added comprehensive unit test `test_creaking_gaze_freeze_carved_pumpkin_and_sway_status_parity`.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/mob/creaking.rs`:

       - `trunk_probability`: 0.4 (40% chance per trunk log to spawn hanging moss underneath if air below).
       - `leaves_probability`: 0.15 (15% chance per foliage leaf block to spawn hanging moss underneath if air below).

### Gap 380: Wind Charge Explosion Knockback & Breeze Entity Attack / Wind Charge Projectile Deflection Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.hurtingprojectile.windcharge.AbstractWindCharge.java:1-156`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.hurtingprojectile.windcharge.WindCharge.java:1-86`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.hurtingprojectile.windcharge.BreezeWindCharge.java:1-42`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.breeze.Breeze.java:42-73, 197-203, 264-266`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity.java:1793-1845`, `net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer.java:1357-1363`, `net.minecraft.world.level.ServerExplosion.java:184-208, 297-310`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.projectile.ProjectileDeflection.java:11-17`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Wind Charge Explosion Multipliers & Parameters*:
     - In `WindCharge.java:24-27`, player-thrown Wind Charge has radius `1.2F` and uses `SimpleExplosionDamageCalculator` with `damagesBlocks = true`, `damagesEntities = false`, and `knockbackMultiplier = Optional.of(1.22F)`.
     - In `BreezeWindCharge.java:13` and `AbstractWindCharge.java:30-33`, Breeze-fired Wind Charge has radius `3.0F` and uses default knockback multiplier `1.0F` (`Optional.empty()`).
     - Normal bounding box Y offset is `-0.15F` (`AbstractWindCharge.java:59-60`).
     - Explosion knockback power scalar formula (`ServerExplosion.java:198`): `(1.0 - dist) * exposure * knockbackMultiplier * (1.0 - knockbackResistance)`.
  2. *Player-Thrown Wind Charge Fall Damage Negation (`ServerPlayer.java:1357-1363`, `LivingEntity.java:1793-1845`)*:
     - When hit by an explosion caused by a player `WIND_CHARGE` (and NOT `BREEZE_WIND_CHARGE`), `ServerPlayer.onExplosionHit` invokes `setIgnoreFallDamageFromCurrentImpulse(true, this.position())`.
     - Records `currentImpulseImpactPos` and sets `currentImpulseContextResetGraceTime = 40` ticks (2 seconds).
     - In `LivingEntity.causeFallDamage`, effective fall distance is calculated as `effectiveFallDistance = Math.min(fallDistance, this.currentImpulseImpactPos.y - this.getY())`.
     - If the player lands at or above their launch height (`effectiveFallDistance <= 0.0`), zero fall damage is dealt and impulse context is reset.
     - If the player lands below their launch height (e.g. into a deep ravine), damage is calculated solely based on the distance fallen below the launch point rather than the entire peak arc.
  3. *Block Triggers & Blocklike Entities Immunity (`ServerExplosion.java:298-310`)*:
     - `canTriggerBlocks`: For player wind charges, always triggers blocks (buttons, levers, doors, trapdoors, bells, pots). For Breeze wind charges, only triggers if `mobGriefing` is true (`ServerExplosion.java:301`).
     - `shouldAffectBlocklikeEntities`: Wind charges (both player and breeze) never destroy or drop blocklike entities (item frames, paintings, armor stands).
  4. *Breeze Projectile Deflection & Damage Immunity (`Breeze.java:197-203, 264-266`, `ProjectileDeflection.java:11-17`)*:
     - Breeze deflects all incoming projectiles (`REVERSE` deflection, velocity multiplied by `-0.5`, yaw rotated by `170.0 + rand * 20.0`), playing `SoundEvents.BREEZE_DEFLECT` (1.0 volume, 1.0 pitch), EXCEPT `WIND_CHARGE` and `BREEZE_WIND_CHARGE`.

### Gap 382: Trial Spawner Ominous State Transformation, Wave Spawns & Mob Equipment Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.trialspawner.TrialSpawner.java:1-431`, `TrialSpawnerState.java:1-299`, `TrialSpawnerStateData.java:1-326`, `TrialSpawnerConfig.java:1-92`, `OminousItemSpawner.java:1-125`, `items_to_drop_when_ominous.json:1-140`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Bad Omen to Trial Omen Transformation (`TrialSpawnerStateData.java:152-162, 203-211`)*:
     - When a player in line of sight of an active or cooling trial spawner has `BAD_OMEN`, it transforms into `TRIAL_OMEN` with duration `18000 * (badOmen.getAmplifier() + 1)` ticks (15 minutes per level, up to 75 minutes at level V).
     - Plays level event `3020` (`ParticlesTrialSpawnerBecomeOminous`) at player eye position with data 0.
     - Invokes `trialSpawner.applyOminous(level, pos)`.
  2. *Ominous State Transformation Mob Clearance & Equipment Dropping (`TrialSpawnerStateData.java:180-200`)*:
     - Spawner block state sets `OMINOUS = true` and emits level event `3020` at spawner position with data 1.
     - Discards all existing `current_mobs`: emits level event `3012` (`ParticlesTrialSpawnerSpawnMobAt`) with normal flame particle (data 0) at each mob position.
     - If the mob had preserved equipment from the trial spawner, it drops that equipment into the world before being removed (`mob.dropPreservedEquipment(level)`).
     - Resets `total_mobs_spawned = 0`, clears `current_mobs`, sets `next_mob_spawns_at = game_time + ominousConfig.ticks_between_spawn`, and sets `cooldown_ends_at = game_time + 160` (ticks between ominous item spawners).
  3. *Ominous Item Spawner Ceiling Raycast & Activation (`TrialSpawnerState.java:160-225`, `OminousItemSpawner.java:70-98`)*:
     - During `ACTIVE` state when `is_ominous == true`, checks every tick if `game_time >= cooldown_ends_at` (160 ticks interval = 8 seconds).
     - Target entity selection: 50% random chance between eligible mobs and eligible players within `required_player_range` (14 blocks).
     - Ceiling position calculation: from target entity position, raycasts upward by `entity_height + 2.0 + rand(0..4)`. Positions drop spawner 1.0 block below collision hit in passable air.
     - Dispenses ominous projectiles / potions:
       - Lingering potions (Wind Charged, Oozing, Weaving, Infested, Strength, Swiftness, Slow Falling) shot downwards.
       - Splash potions shot downwards.
       - Wind charges shot downwards.
       - Arrows & tipped arrows shot downwards.
       - Fire charges shot downwards.
       - Items spawned as item entities.
     - Plays `SoundEvents.TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAWN_ITEM_BEGIN` with pitch `(rand - rand) * 0.2 + 1.0` and emits event `3021` (`ParticlesTrialSpawnerSpawnItem`) with data 1 upon projectile launch.
  4. *Trial Spawner Wave Mob Scaling (`TrialSpawnerConfig.java:59, 63`)*:
     - `totalMobs`: `floor(base_total + added_per_player * (players - 1))`.
     - `simultaneousMobs`: `floor(base_simul + added_per_player * (players - 1))`.
- **Implementation**:

    - Updated `apply_ominous` to drop preserved equipment from mobs before removing, and schedule `cooldown_ends_at` to `game_time + ticks_between_item_spawners()`.
    - Added `spawn_ominous_item_spawner`, `calculate_position_to_spawn_item_spawner`, and `pick_item_to_dispense_when_ominous`.
    - Hooked `spawn_ominous_item_spawner` into `TrialSpawnerState::Active` when spawner is ominous.
    - Used `world.play_sound_fine` with randomized pitch for ominous item spawner activation.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/ominous_item_spawner.rs`:

### Gap 383: Vault & Ominous Vault Key Interaction, Loot Ejection & Player Lockout Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.VaultBlock.java:1-125`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.vault.VaultBlockEntity.java:1-260`, `VaultServerData.java:1-145`, `VaultSharedData.java:1-120`, `VaultState.java:1-155`, `VaultConfig.java:1-60`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Player Activation & Connected Range Filtering (`VaultBlockEntity.java:82-95`, `VaultSharedData.java:65-75`)*:
     - Activation range is `4.0` blocks (`ACTIVATION_RANGE = 4.0`), deactivation range is `4.5` blocks (`DEACTIVATION_RANGE = 4.5`).
     - Only alive, non-spectator/non-creative players within activation range who have NOT already been rewarded (`!serverData.getRewardedPlayers().contains(player.getUUID())`) activate the vault.
     - When an unrewarded player enters activation range, vault transitions from `INACTIVE` to `ACTIVE`, changing block state light emission (inactive = light level 6, active = light level 12) and emitting world event `3015` (`AnimationVaultActivate`) with data `is_ominous ? 1 : 0`.
     - When all unrewarded players leave deactivation range, vault transitions to `INACTIVE` and emits world event `3016` (`AnimationVaultDeactivate`).
     - Vault periodically plays ambient sound `SoundEvents.VAULT_AMBIENT` (2% chance per check tick = `0.02F`) while in `ACTIVE` state.
  2. *Key Insertion Validation & Rate Limiting (`VaultBlockEntity.java:175-198`)*:
     - Right-clicking an `INACTIVE` vault returns `InteractionResult.PASS` without consuming items or playing failure sounds.
     - Right-clicking an `ACTIVE` vault with an invalid key plays `SoundEvents.VAULT_INSERT_ITEM_FAIL`, throttled by a 15-tick cooldown (`lastInsertFailTimestamp + 15L`).
     - Regular vault accepts `Item::TRIAL_KEY`; Ominous vault accepts `Item::OMINOUS_TRIAL_KEY`.
     - Right-clicking an active vault by a player already in `rewarded_players` plays `SoundEvents.VAULT_REJECT_REWARDED_PLAYER`, throttled by 15 ticks.
  3. *Loot Ejection Pitch Scaling & Shutter Animation (`VaultServerData.java:88-95`, `VaultState.java:128`)*:
     - Ejection sound pitch scales dynamically from 0.8 up to 1.2 using formula: `0.8F + 0.4F * ejectionSoundProgress`.
     - `ejectionSoundProgress = totalEjectionsNeeded == 1 ? 1.0F : 1.0F - inverseLerp(remainingItems, 1.0F, totalEjectionsNeeded)`.
     - Emits world event `3017` (`AnimationVaultEjectItem`) with data `is_ominous ? 1 : 0` on every ejection tick.
  4. *Rewarded Players Storage & Cap (`VaultServerData.java:60`)*:
     - Stores UUIDs of players who received rewards; capped at `128` (`MAX_REWARDED_PLAYERS = 128`).
     - When exceeding 128 players, the oldest player entry is evicted.

    - Implemented `BlockEntity::tick` on `VaultBlockEntity` checking player activation (4.0m) / deactivation (4.5m) ranges, filtering out already-rewarded players.
    - Synchronized block state transition between `Active` and `Inactive` with world events 3015/3016, and scheduled ambient sound with 2% probability.
    - Added `can_play_insert_fail_sound(current_tick)` and `set_last_insert_fail_timestamp(current_tick)` with 15-tick throttling.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/blocks/vault.rs`:

### Gap 384: Bundle Capacity, Nested Bundle Weight (1/16 = 4/64), Bar Fullness & Container Shulker Rejection Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.item.BundleItem.java:36-40, 154-169, 221-234`, `net.minecraft.world.item.component.BundleContents.java:36, 73-93, 107-124`, `net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem.java:195-197`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Bundle Capacity & Weight System (`BundleContents.java:36, 73-85`)*:
     - Total capacity is 64 weight units (`Fraction.ONE`).
     - Normal items consume weight inversely proportional to their max stack size: `(64 / max_stack_size) * count`.
       - Stack size 64: 1 unit per item (e.g. 64 dirt blocks = 64/64 = 1.0).
       - Stack size 16: 4 units per item (e.g. 16 ender pearls = 64/64 = 1.0).
       - Stack size 1: 64 units per item (e.g. 1 sword = 64/64 = 1.0).
  2. *Nested Bundle Weight (`BundleContents.java:36, 80-82`)*:
     - Vanilla explicitly allows nested bundles (bundles inside other bundles).
     - Nested bundle weight is `BUNDLE_IN_BUNDLE_WEIGHT = Fraction.getFraction(1, 16)` = 4/64 units base + recursive inner items' weight.
     - An outer bundle can hold up to 16 empty nested bundles (16 * 4 = 64), or bundles containing partial contents up to 64 total units.
  3. *Container Item Rejection (`BlockItem.java:195-197`, `BundleContents.java:107-111`)*:
     - `canItemBeInBundle(ItemStack)` calls `item.canFitInsideContainerItems()`.
     - In Vanilla, only Shulker Boxes return `false` for `canFitInsideContainerItems()`. All other items (including Bundles!) can fit inside bundles.
  4. *Durability Bar Visibility, Width & Color (`BundleItem.java:36-37, 154-169`)*:
     - Bar is visible when weight > 0 (`isBarVisible(stack)`).
     - Bar width scales from 1 to 13 pixels: `Math.min(1 + 12 * weight / 64, 13)`.
     - Bar color is red `FULL_BAR_COLOR = 0xFFFF5454` when weight >= 64, and blue `BAR_COLOR = 0xFF7087FF` when weight < 64.
  5. *Grid Item Count Calculation (`BundleContents.java:87-93`)*:
     - If size <= 12, all items are displayed (up to 3 rows of 4 columns).
     - If size > 12, available item slots = 11 (reserving 1 slot for "+X more"), reduced by incomplete row padding `(4 - (size % 4))`.
  6. *Use & Drop Timings (`BundleItem.java:38-40, 221-234`)*:
     - `TICKS_MAX_THROW_DURATION = 200`.
     - First item drops immediately on tick 200.
     - Ticks 199..=190 pause for initial throw delay (`TICKS_AFTER_FIRST_THROW = 10`).
     - Subsequent items drop every 2 ticks (`TICKS_BETWEEN_THROWS = 2`, `remaining_ticks % 2 == 0`).
- **Implementation**:
  - In `crates/pumpkin-data/src/data_component_impl/utility.rs`:
    - Updated `BundleContentsImpl` to support nested bundles with `BUNDLE_IN_BUNDLE_WEIGHT = 4`, `FULL_BUNDLE_WEIGHT = 64`, `is_bundle_item`, recursive `weight_of`, and `can_item_be_in_bundle` rejecting only Shulker Boxes (`tag::Item::MINECRAFT_SHULKER_BOXES`).
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/item/items/bundle.rs`:
    - Added constants `FULL_BAR_COLOR`, `BAR_COLOR`, `MAX_SHOWN_GRID_ITEMS`, `TICKS_MAX_THROW_DURATION`, `TICKS_AFTER_FIRST_THROW`, `TICKS_BETWEEN_THROWS`.
    - Added helper methods `is_bar_visible`, `get_bar_width`, `get_bar_color`, `get_fullness_display`, `get_number_of_items_to_show`.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`:
    - Exported constants `BUNDLE_FULL_WEIGHT = 64`, `BUNDLE_IN_BUNDLE_WEIGHT = 4`, `BUNDLE_FULL_BAR_COLOR = 0xFFFF_5454`, `BUNDLE_BAR_COLOR = 0xFF70_87FF`, `BUNDLE_MAX_SHOWN_GRID_ITEMS_X = 4`, `BUNDLE_MAX_SHOWN_GRID_ITEMS_Y = 3`, `BUNDLE_MAX_SHOWN_GRID_ITEMS = 12`, `BUNDLE_OVERFLOWING_MAX_SHOWN_GRID_ITEMS = 11`, `BUNDLE_TICKS_MAX_THROW_DURATION = 200`, `BUNDLE_TICKS_AFTER_FIRST_THROW = 10`, `BUNDLE_TICKS_BETWEEN_THROWS = 2`.

### Gap 386: Decorated Pot Projectile Shattering, Tool Breakdown vs Silk Touch Preservation, Insertion Pitch Scaling & Comparator Signal Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.DecoratedPotBlock.java:1-247`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.DecoratedPotBlockEntity.java:1-187`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.PotDecorations.java:1-66`, `net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.java:762-782`, `net.minecraft.data.loot.packs.VanillaBlockLoot.java`, `net.minecraft.tags.ItemTags.java:BREAKS_DECORATED_POTS`, `net.minecraft.tags.EnchantmentTags.java:PREVENTS_DECORATED_POT_SHATTERING`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Tool Breakdown vs Silk Touch Preservation (`DecoratedPotBlock.java:188-197`, `VanillaBlockLoot`)*:
     - When mined with a tool tagged `#minecraft:breaks_decorated_pots` (swords, axes, pickaxes, shovels, hoes, trident, mace) that does NOT have `#minecraft:prevents_decorated_pot_shattering` (Silk Touch), `playerWillDestroy` sets block property `CRACKED = true`.
     - When `CRACKED` is true: The pot loot table evaluates `Inverted(cracked == true)` as false (dropping 0 decorated pots), dynamic drop `minecraft:sherds` drops the 4 constituent sherds or bricks, sound `SoundType.DECORATED_POT_CRACKED` / `BlockDecoratedPotShatter` plays, and the single contained item drops via container removal side effects.
     - When broken with bare hands, non-tool items, or a Silk Touch enchanted tool: `CRACKED` remains `false`. The pot loot table drops 1 intact `minecraft:decorated_pot` retaining its `minecraft:pot_decorations` component, and no sherds/shatter sound are produced.
  2. *Duplicate Drop Bug Fix*:
     - Previously in Neth, `DecoratedPotBlock::broken` unconditionally dropped a duplicate decorated pot when not shattered (`else { drop_stack(Item::DECORATED_POT) }`), while `break_block` also dropped a pot via loot table evaluation, duplicating pots and stripping their decorations. Removing the manual non-shatter drop ensures 100% parity with vanilla loot tables.
     - Setting `broken_block_state` to cracked state in `break_block` when broken with a shattering tool prevents the intact loot table from rolling a duplicate decorated pot alongside sherds.
  3. *Impact Projectile Shattering (`DecoratedPotBlock.java:210-216`)*:
     - Any projectile in `#minecraft:impact_projectiles` (arrow, spectral arrow, trident, snowball, egg, fireball, small fireball, dragon fireball, wither skull, wind charge, breeze wind charge, firework rocket) with interaction rights shatters the pot, dropping the 4 sherds/bricks and releasing its contained item.
  4. *Insert Pitch Scaling & Wobble Synced Block Events (`DecoratedPotBlock.java:108-145`, `DecoratedPotBlockEntity.java:160-186`)*:
     - Insert sound pitch formula: `0.7F + 0.5F * (count / maxStackSize)`. Scales smoothly from `0.7` up to `1.2`.
     - Successful insertion triggers positive wobble: synced block event `1`, data `0` (`EVENT_POT_WOBBLES`, positive duration 7 ticks), and spawns 7 `Particle::DustPlume` particles at `(x + 0.5, y + 1.2, z + 0.5)`.
     - Failed insertion (pot full, item mismatch) or empty-hand interaction plays `DECORATED_POT_INSERT_FAIL` and triggers negative wobble: synced block event `1`, data `1` (negative duration 10 ticks).
  5. *Comparator Analog Redstone Output (`AbstractContainerMenu.java:762-782`, `Mth.lerpDiscrete`)*:
     - Formula: `0` if empty; otherwise `1 + floor((count / maxStackSize) * 14.0)` (range 1 to 15).
     - Single items of non-stackable gear (saddles, tools) output full power 15 immediately.
- **Implementation**:
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/blocks/decorated_pot.rs`:
    - Added positive wobble event (`EVENT_POT_WOBBLES`, `PotWobbleStyle::Positive`) and 7 `Particle::DustPlume` particles on successful item insertion in `use_with_item`.
    - Added negative wobble event on failed item insertion and on empty-hand `normal_use`.
    - Implemented `on_synced_block_event` to handle wobble events.
    - Removed duplicate manual drop in `broken` so intact pot drop is handled by the vanilla loot table with full `pot_decorations` preservation.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/world/mod.rs`:
    - Updated `break_block` to set `broken_block_state` to `r#cracked = true` when broken by a player holding a tool in `#breaks_decorated_pots` without Silk Touch, matching `DecoratedPotBlock.playerWillDestroy`.
  - In `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`:
    - Added comprehensive unit test `test_decorated_pot_shattering_silk_touch_insertion_pitch_and_comparator_parity` covering constants, tool break tests, silk touch preservation, impact projectiles, pitch scaling, and comparator formulas.
- **Status**: Completed & Verified.


### Gap 387: Creaking Heart Silk Touch vs Resin Clump Loot Drop, Natural Heart XP, Comparator Distance Signal & Log Check Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.CreakingHeartBlock.java:1-196`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.CreakingHeartBlockEntity.java:1-355`, `net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.creaking.Creaking.java:294-328`, `net.minecraft.data.loot.packs.VanillaBlockLoot.java` (`BLOCKS_CREAKING_HEART`), `net.minecraft.tags.BlockTags.java:PALE_OAK_LOGS`.

### Gap 388: Moss Block & Pale Moss Block Bonemeal Spreading and Vegetation Patch Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.BonemealableFeaturePlacerBlock.java:1-44`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.MossyCarpetBlock.java:159-201`, `net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.VegetationPatchFeature.java:1-179`, `net.minecraft.data.worldgen.features.CaveFeatures.java:383-425` (`MOSS_PATCH_BONEMEAL`, `MOSS_VEGETATION`), `net.minecraft.data.worldgen.features.VegetationFeatures.java:295-335` (`PALE_MOSS_PATCH_BONEMEAL`, `PALE_MOSS_VEGETATION`), `net.minecraft.tags.BlockTags.java:MOSS_REPLACEABLE`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks.java:5323-5327`, `5518-5522`.
- **Vanilla Mechanics**:
  1. *Bonemealable Feature Placer Parity (`BonemealableFeaturePlacerBlock.java:23-29`, `Blocks.java`)*:
     - Both `minecraft:moss_block` and `minecraft:pale_moss_block` in vanilla are instances of `BonemealableFeaturePlacerBlock`.
     - `isValidBonemealTarget`: Returns `true` if and only if the block directly above the moss block is air (`level.getBlockState(pos.above()).isAir()`).
     - `isBonemealSuccess`: Returns `true`.
     - Previously in Neth, neither `MOSS_BLOCK` nor `PALE_MOSS_BLOCK` had any block behaviour registered in `BlockRegistry`, causing bone meal on both blocks to fail and do nothing.
  2. *Vegetation Patch Generation (`VegetationPatchFeature.java:91-178`)*:
     - Origin is `pos.above()`.
     - Horizontal search radius `xzRadius` samples `UniformInt.of(1, 2) + 1` giving an independent radius of 2 or 3 in the X and Z axes.
     - Patch column filtering (`VegetationPatchFeature.java:121`):
       - Corner columns (`dx == +/-xRadius && dz == +/-zRadius`) are always excluded.
       - Edge columns that are not corners are included with probability `0.75` (`extraEdgeColumnChance = 0.75F`).
       - Non-edge interior columns are always included.
     - For each column, searches up to `verticalRange = 5` downwards and upwards to locate the floor ground level where the top face of the ground block is sturdy.
     - Replaces valid ground blocks matching `#minecraft:moss_replaceable` with the respective moss block:
       - Overworld base stones: `stone`, `granite`, `diorite`, `andesite`, `tuff`, `deepslate`.
       - Dirt & mud: `dirt`, `coarse_dirt`, `rooted_dirt`, `mud`, `muddy_mangrove_roots`.
       - Grasses: `grass_block`, `podzol`, `mycelium`.
       - Mosses & cave vines: `moss_block`, `pale_moss_block`, `cave_vines`, `cave_vines_plant`.
  3. *Vegetation Placement Distribution (`CaveFeatures.java`, `VegetationFeatures.java`)*:
     - Ground blocks in the patch have a `0.60` (`vegetationChance = 0.60F`) probability to generate vegetation on their upper surface if the space above is air.
     - *Normal Moss Vegetation (`MOSS_VEGETATION`, total weight 96)*:
       - `minecraft:flowering_azalea`: weight 4 (~4.2%)
       - `minecraft:azalea`: weight 7 (~7.3%)
       - `minecraft:moss_carpet`: weight 25 (~26.0%)
       - `minecraft:short_grass`: weight 50 (~52.1%)
       - `minecraft:tall_grass`: weight 10 (~10.4%, placed as a 2-block tall double plant)
     - *Pale Moss Vegetation (`PALE_MOSS_VEGETATION`, total weight 60)*:
       - `minecraft:pale_moss_carpet`: weight 25 (~41.7%, placed with side wall toppers if adjacent to solid walls)
       - `minecraft:short_grass`: weight 25 (~41.7%)
       - `minecraft:tall_grass`: weight 10 (~16.7%, placed as a 2-block tall double plant)
- **Implementation**:
  - Created `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/blocks/moss.rs` implementing `MossBlock` handling both `BlockId::MOSS_BLOCK` and `BlockId::PALE_MOSS_BLOCK`.
  - Implemented `is_valid_bonemeal_target`, `is_bonemeal_success`, and `perform_bonemeal` with full `perform_moss_patch_bonemeal` implementation matching vanilla `VegetationPatchFeature`.
  - Registered `MossBlock` in `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/blocks/mod.rs` and `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/registry.rs`.
  - Added unit tests in `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/blocks/moss.rs` and `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`.
- **Status**: Completed & Verified.


### Gap 389: Firefly Bush Bonemeal Spread, Ambient Sound & Particle Dynamics Parity
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.FireflyBushBlock.java:1-57`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.BonemealableBlock.java:20-39`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.VegetationBlock.java:1-54`, `net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.java:FIREFLY_BUSH_IDLE`, `net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes.java:FIREFLY`.

  1. *Horizontal Bonemeal Spreading (`FireflyBushBlock.java:44-56`, `BonemealableBlock.java:20-39`)*:
     - `isValidBonemealTarget`: Checks horizontal neighboring blocks (North, South, East, West) via `BonemealableBlock.hasSpreadableNeighbourPos`.

       If all 4 horizontal neighbors are blocked or cannot support the bush, returns `false`.
     - `isBonemealSuccess`: Returns `true`.
     - `performBonemeal`: Randomly shuffles horizontal directions (`findSpreadableNeighbourPos`), selects the first valid position, and places `FIREFLY_BUSH` there!
     - Previously in Neth, `FIREFLY_BUSH` was bundled into generic `BushBlock` (`[BUSH, FIREFLY_BUSH, RED_SHRUB]`), which had no bonemeal implementation, causing bone meal on Firefly Bush to fail and do nothing.

     - Spawns when local brightness level <= 13 (`FIREFLY_SPAWN_MAX_BRIGHTNESS_LEVEL = 13`).
     - Tick chance: 0.70 (`FIREFLY_CHANCE_PER_TICK = 0.7`).
     - Particle spread: Horizontal range 10.0 (`X: pos.x + [-5.0, 5.0]`, `Z: pos.z + [-5.0, 5.0]`), Vertical range 5.0 (`Y: pos.y + [0.0, 5.0]`).

### Gap 390: Creaking Heart Breadth-First Resin Clump Spreading, Multiface Orientation & Hurt Trail Particles Parity
- **Status**: Fixed
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.CreakingHeartBlockEntity.java:233-306`, `net.minecraft.core.BlockPos.java:311-352` (`breadthFirstTraversal`), `net.minecraft.core.particles.TrailParticleOption.java`, `net.minecraft.world.level.block.MultifaceBlock.java`.
- **Description**:
  1. **Multiface Resin Clump Orientation**: Resin Clump (`RESIN_CLUMP`) uses multiface orientation properties (`ResinClumpProperties` / `GlowLichenLikeProperties`). Previously, Neth placed `Block::RESIN_CLUMP.default_state.id` which has all 6 directional faces set to `false`. Multiface blocks without any attached active face are invalid and break. In vanilla, the face facing the pale oak log (`dir.opposite()`) is set to `true`. Furthermore, if the target block already has a `RESIN_CLUMP`, vanilla preserves existing active faces and adds the new face. If the block is a water source (`WATER` with `level == 0`), vanilla preserves waterlogged status (`waterlogged = true`).
  2. **Breadth-First Traversal (BFS) Spreading**: Previously, Neth only searched immediate adjacent coordinates (depth 1). Vanilla executes `BlockPos.breadthFirstTraversal(this.worldPosition, 2, 64, neighbourProvider, nodeProcessor)` along pale oak logs up to depth 2 and up to 64 visited log blocks, with randomized direction ordering at each step.
  3. **Hurt Sequence & Emitter Cooldown**: In vanilla, when the Creaking protector takes damage, `creakingHurt()` only proceeds if `emitter <= 0` (cooldown protection). If ready, it emits 20 trail particles towards the heart, spawns 2 to 3 resin clumps via BFS when the heart is in `AWAKE` state, and sets `emitter = 100`.
  4. **Hurt Trail Particles & Sound Interpolation**: Each tick in `serverTick`, while `emitter > 50`, vanilla emits dual trail particles between the heart and the creaking entity (`TRAIL_COLOR_TOWARDS_CREAKING = 16545810`, `TRAIL_COLOR_TOWARDS_HEART = 6250335`). Every 10 ticks while emitter is active, the hurt sound `BlockCreakingHeartHurt` is played at an interpolated position traveling from the creaking towards the creaking heart: `(heart_pos - emitter_target) * progress + emitter_target`, where `progress = 0.2 + 0.8 * (100 - emitter) / 100.0`.
- **Tests Added**:
  - `crates/pumpkin-core/src/block/entities/creaking_heart.rs`: `test_resin_clump_multiface_orientation_and_waterlogged`, `test_creaking_heart_resin_bfs_and_trail_constants`, `test_hurt_sound_location_interpolation`.
  - `crates/pumpkin-core/src/entity/combat.rs`: `test_creaking_heart_resin_bfs_multiface_orientation_and_hurt_trail_parity`.

### Gap 391: Shelf Mushroom Tree Decorator & Fallen Log Generation Parity
- **Status**: Fixed
- **Vanilla Reference**: `net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.feature.treedecorators.ShelfMushroomDecorator.java:1-125`, `TreeDecoratorType.java:1-35` (`SHELF_MUSHROOM`), `TreeFeatures.java:184, 670-692`, `ShelfMushroomBlock.java:1-60`.
- **Description**:
  1. **Missing Tree Decorator Type**: In Vanilla Minecraft 1.21.4, `TreeDecoratorType` defines 11 distinct decorators. While 10 decorators were present in Neth, `ShelfMushroomDecorator` (`TreeDecoratorType.SHELF_MUSHROOM`) was completely missing from `TreeDecorator` in `pumpkin-world`. It is used by Vanilla to decorate fallen trees (with probability `0.8F = 80%`) and poplar trees (`RED_POPLAR`, `ORANGE_POPLAR`, `YELLOW_POPLAR` with probability `0.4F = 40%`).
  2. **Standing Tree Placement**: For standing trees, mushrooms only generate within decoratable height bounds (`MIN_HEIGHT_OFFSET = 1`, `MAX_HEIGHT_OFFSET = 4` blocks above tree base). Two perpendicular horizontal directions (`first` and `first.clockwise()`) are selected. Each direction has a `0.25` (25%) placement chance. Mushroom cannot generate if another shelf mushroom is directly below.
  3. **Fallen Log Placement**: For fallen trees (identified by `first.y == last.y`), perpendicular horizontal directions are computed based on tree axis (North/South for X-axis logs; East/West for Z-axis logs). Mushrooms generate with `0.25` chance per side only if no horizontally adjacent shelf mushrooms exist around the log or the target position.
  4. **Property & Age Assignment**: Generated shelf mushrooms set `age` to random integer in `0..=1` (`MAX_AGE_EXCLUSIVE = 2`) and `facing` to the chosen `HorizontalFacing`, generating properly sturdy attached mushroom shelves.
- **Tests Added**:
